names.wheeler_house_1812_prairie: 1812 Prairie Avenue — George H. Wheeler house (Burnham & Root, 1884), a stone and brick front under a shaped Flemish gable

source.citation: 1812 S. Prairie Ave. About 1955. Photograph of the street front of the George H. Wheeler house from the walk across Prairie Avenue, a little south of square, with 1808 Prairie's stone front at the right; unknown photographer, about 1955. Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 1812 S. Prairie.
what_it_does_not_supply: the 1904 state where it differs from Levy's print: it is fifty years later

the south wall's face in the gap to 1816 and the projection's south cheek, which Levy's square view cannot see
